name: averitec-chrono-v1
rule: Population: dated AVeriTeC train+dev claims minus removed exact-byte duplicates (PREREG 7) and, per exclude_empty_text, empty claim strings (operator decision 3, pending); undated claims excluded and listed (PREREG 6). cutoff_date = the latest claim date d with denominator * #(dated > d) >= numerator * n_dated (PREREG 4, test_share_min 1/5, integer arithmetic). test = dated strictly after the cutoff; claims on the cutoff day are train/val. val = pre-cutoff ids with (int.from_bytes(sha256(claim_id), 'big') >> 64) % 5 == 0 (val_rule, operator decision 4, pending); val_fuse if int.from_bytes(sha256(claim_id), 'big') % 2 == 0 else val_cal (PREREG 8); train = the rest. Partitions sorted by (split rank train=0 dev=1, idx).
